summary: Cursor: HD art only; retire game_dialogs sheet 008
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25: "Yes the hd cursors should have replaced 008 sd cursors" (decision d-036, no fallbacks).

| fact | value |
|---|---|
| HD path | `interface/cursors_hq.png` + `.json`, frames 0-12, drawn by `m_cursor_art.draw` (`cursor_art.cpp:90-104`) - verified by the audit |
| fallback | `game.cpp:615-646` draws `m_sprite[MouseCursor]` (game_dialogs sheet 008) when the HQ art fails or a frame is missing; `game.cpp:632-641` holds an item-target special case only on that path |
| load | `screen_loading.cpp:178` (MouseCursor = sheet 008) |

**Done when:** the cursor draws only from the HQ art; the item-target special case is reproduced on the HQ path (or shown to be obsolete); the 008 load and id are gone; `game_dialogs/008.png` is replaced by an empty placeholder and archived byte-identical; and both builds are clean with an in-client check of the normal and item-target cursors.

Source: user message and fallback audit, 2026-11-25.
